verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first search engine, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no spec at any common candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json all return 404), and no documentation in the pack mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, typed SDKs and MCP server are not machine-readable API specifications, so they do not count toward this story.
